claim_text: In No. 0:22-cr-00223, Abdihakim Ali Ahmed was sentenced on August 26, 2026 to 54 months for one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering; Ahmed Abdullahi Ghedi was sentenced the same day to 65 months on the same two counts; and Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim (aka Salah Donyale) was sentenced August 27, 2026 to 36 months for one count of wire fraud. USAO-MN described the three as the 24th, 25th, and 26th Feeding Our Future defendants sentenced. USAO-MN's release does not state restitution amounts; Fox News separately reported Ahmed was ordered to pay $2,242,590 and Ghedi $2,862,451 in restitution.
